notes: Timeline: CAZ plans announced and Class D (incl. cars) consulted on Oct 2018; cabinet unanimously chose Class C on 5 Mar 2019 (= decision_date; this is the '5 March' seen in some sources); government approved Class C May 2019; launch planned Nov/Dec 2020, delayed by COVID; charging 15 Mar 2021 (gov.uk change history, B&NES cabinet report Sep 2021). Launched during COVID recovery.

Timeline: cabinet approved Class D preferred option 10 Sep 2018 (UK100, secondary; verify against council minutes); full business case approved by cabinet 11 Dec 2018; government approved Class D Mar 2019; zone operational 1 Jun 2021 with two-week soft launch (no charges or enforcement); charging from 14 Jun 2021. Area inside the A4540 Middleway (ring road excluded). Council site brumbreathes.co.uk blocks automated fetch. Launched during COVID recovery.

Timeline: cabinet chose Class B preferred option 9 Sep 2019; outline business case approved 29 Oct 2019; ministerial direction requiring Class B Mar 2020; cabinet set start date late Sep 2021. Class B: buses, coaches, taxis, PHVs, HGVs only (no vans, no cars). Small zone in south-west Portsea Island.

Timeline: Class C consultation Feb 2020; full business case (Class C) submitted Dec 2020; Executive resolved to implement Class C 2 Mar 2021; charging 26 Sep 2022 under ministerial direction. Council brands it C+ (stricter standard for taxis). Large zone: inside outer ring road plus corridor to Shipley and Saltaire.

Timeline: Nov 2019 plan was a different design (medium Class C zone plus diesel car ban); cabinet approved small Class D zone 25 Feb 2021; ministerial direction 1 Nov 2021; start date announced by council ~6 Jul 2022 (gov.uk 18 Jul 2022). Small central zone.

Timeline: Newcastle cabinet 16 Dec 2019 and Gateshead cabinet 17 Dec 2019 backed final Class C plan, confirmed by full councils early 2020 (exact date not found; verify); government approval reported 3 Apr 2020; start delayed from Jan 2021 to Jul 2022 to Jan 2023; revised plan submitted Oct 2021, approved Apr 2022. Zone: Newcastle centre plus Tyne bridges. LGV temporary exemption ended 1 Sep 2023 (second, partial treatment date).

Timeline: cabinet approved outline business case for a charging Class C+ zone on and within the inner ring road 21 Nov 2018; government approval reported May 2019 and Mar 2020; delayed 2020 (COVID); full business case Mar 2022, approved by government Jun 2022. Implemented as Class C. A temporary exemption ended 5 Jun 2023 (gov.uk change history).

Timeline: bus-only Phase 1 since 31 Dec 2018 (concurrent policy, rising Euro VI share); Phase 2 (all vehicles) consulted 2021; final scheme approved by City Administration Committee 10 Mar 2022; ministers approved spring 2022; enforced 1 Jun 2023; residents inside the zone from 1 Jun 2024. LEZ = entry ban with penalty charges, not a daily charge.

Timeline: committee approved applying to ministers 21 Feb 2022; LEZ introduced 30 May 2022 with two-year grace period (anticipation possible); enforced 30 May 2024. LEZ = entry ban with penalty charges.

Timeline: City Growth and Resources Committee approved preferred option and authorised submission to ministers 24 Jun 2021 (no 2022 final-submission decision found); LEZ introduced 30 May 2022 with two-year grace period; enforced 1 Jun 2024. LEZ = entry ban with penalty charges.

Timeline: Transport and Environment Committee approved final scheme for submission 31 Mar 2022; ministerial approval letter 19 May 2022; LEZ introduced 30 May 2022 with two-year grace period; enforced 1 Jun 2024. LEZ = entry ban with penalty charges.
